raw_record.standard_answer: Do not reject the null hypothesis concluding that there is no evidence that the proportion is higher for women.

method.method_draft: Read the table in the image: Male row has 152 approving out of 254 surveyed, and Female row has 199 approving out of 301 surveyed. From the question text, set up a one-sided two-proportion test at alpha = 0.05 for whether the approval proportion is higher for women: H0: p_female = p_male versus Ha: p_female > p_male. Compute sample proportions 199/301 and 152/254, then use the pooled two-proportion z-test standard error under H0. Calculate z = (p_hat_female - p_hat_male)/SE_pooled and compare its one-tailed p-value to 0.05. Since the resulting p-value is greater than 0.05, do not reject H0 and conclude there is not sufficient evidence that the approval proportion is higher for women.
